note: Task-type contract for prompt writing. Content rules live in prompt-writing.md; this file records, per task, which principles carry the load, which syntax the target actually supports, and which deterministic checks apply. Weights/negative/timing are false unless a target genuinely supports them; do not add syntax that a renderer will read literally as text.

character_sheet.positive: one person, four views, identical wardrobe and asymmetries in every view
forbid: reproducing panels or separators as content
inventing a second character from two views

location_plate.positive: one connected empty architectural space and its fixed anchors
preserve: approved layout, openings, railings, materials, fixed marks for this target
forbid: people
fixtures or fire from another time of day
a tour through several floors

prop_design.positive: silhouette, material, proportions and stable distinguishing marks
preserve: current declared physical state when the frame depends on it
forbid: inheriting the owner's acting or biography
letting a design reference decide the object's current switch or fill state

still_frame.positive: one consistent instant, named subjects, actor-specific hand ownership, motivated viewpoint
forbid: a second later instant in the same frame
camera-motion trails
sequential action panels

exact_start_keyframe.positive: the opening instant exactly as the authoritative state describes it
preserve: ownership and contact at that instant
forbid: carrying the later gesture, contact or outcome into the frame
substituting the opening for an intermediate moment

portrait.positive: one photographic portrait of the described subject at the target moment
forbid: substituting the reference's staging for the requested portrait

image_edit.positive: explicitly what changes, and explicitly what is preserved
preserve: the edit target's body, hair, wardrobe, pose unless changed
forbid: a change request hidden inside a defect observation
restating the whole target instead of the delta

scene_global.positive: this location's reusable appearance, light and atmosphere, plus the reference subject definitions
preserve: each assigned Subject N to Picture N mapping
forbid: shot-specific blocking or camera
prop inventories
dialogue
plot recap
future events

shot_prompt.positive: this shot's own camera, blocking, acting, actions, timing and sound
preserve: exact scripted utterances, language tags, timings, prop ownership and causality
forbid: neighbouring shots' dialogue or actions
editorial bookkeeping
invented story events

video_i2va.positive: ordered movement from the supplied source image across the configured duration
forbid: restating the source image as a still description
freezing the whole duration

video_fl2va.positive: movement that legitimately arrives at the supplied ending state
forbid: a route that cannot reach the ending state
static description of either frame alone

video_ref2va.positive: reusable reference identities plus this shot's ordered action
forbid: treating a reference as the opening composition it does not supply
reference-defined switch or pose state

montage_group.positive: one generation covering a planned multi-shot group with real internal progression
preserve: authorised non-diegetic music and overall soundscape
forbid: treating an intentionally designed montage as a continuity fault
removing planned actions to satisfy a single-shot rule
